entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Of course, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We have been recently condemned by..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have been recently condemned by a number of ATO member states for our invasion of Pales."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""They are threatening sanctions.""
entries.dialogueText: "They are threatening sanctions."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""However, your meeting with Prime M..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, your meeting with Prime Minister Alvarez was very fruitful. I am not sure if we can trust him to veto the sanctions -- but he's our best bet in averting a major crisis."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""In your meeting with Prime Ministe..."
entries.dialogueText: "In your meeting with Prime Minister Alvarez, he threatened to approve the sanctions as well. Unfortunately, all of this would be a crippling blow for our trade."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I'd like to first congratulate you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd like to first congratulate you for receiving a promise from Prime Minister Alvarez on supporting us at the MITZ vote."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I'd like to first congratulate you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd like to first congratulate you for brokering a deal with Prime Minister Alvarez."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We are slowly normalizing our rela..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are slowly normalizing our relations with Lespia. Your meeting with Prime Minister Alvarez was very helpful."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Our relations with Lespia are dete..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our relations with Lespia are deteriorating rapidly. Our meeting with Prime Minister Alvarez didn't exactly go as planned."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""However, your decision to lease Ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, your decision to lease Caleqabiz to ATO, I believe, has sparked some outrage within Rizia."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It is of course welcomed by Arcasi..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is of course welcomed by Arcasia and the ATO as a whole."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""This move aligns us directly with..."
entries.dialogueText: "This move aligns us directly with the ATO -- which presents a new direction for our foreign policy. This will in turn antagonize countries aligned with the CSP."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We've also received word that, as..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've also received word that, as part of our deal, the pipeline extension to Lespia is already underway and continues without problems."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Chancellor Hegel has already conde..."
entries.dialogueText: "Chancellor Hegel has already condemned the decision."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""On the other hand, LesPower has be..."
entries.dialogueText: "On the other hand, LesPower has been supplying us with energy since our deal was signed."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Lespia is an important partner and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia is an important partner and a potential threat. We must tread carefully with them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Great news. I hope to see some gre..."
entries.dialogueText: "Great news. I hope to see some great returns in the future."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This will surely help our standing..."
entries.dialogueText: "This will surely help our standing with them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am already aware of this, Mr. Es..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am already aware of this, Mr. Esquibel."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Honestly, I don't trust them one b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Honestly, I don't trust them one bit. We should always expect the worst."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Agreed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Agreed."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's not good. We cannot risk an..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's not good. We cannot risk any confrontation with Valgsland."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course he did. Frankly, we shou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course he did. Frankly, we shouldn't care less. They were, and will never be, on our side."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is good news. Having some sup..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is good news. Having some support from Arcasia puts us in a good spot. We should try to use this to our advantage."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Giving Caleqabiz to ATO was a diff..."
entries.dialogueText: "Giving Caleqabiz to ATO was a difficult decision to make. We should watch them carefully. Remember, Arcasia or their satellite states are not our allies."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Exactly, Your Majesty. This can op..."
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly, Your Majesty. This can open up many doors for us. Especially to Western Merkopa."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""This is a good position to be in b..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is a good position to be in but we should tread lightly on that road. Arcasia cannot be trusted."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Once you enter from that door, the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Once you enter from that door, there is no turning back. Arcasia doesn't help anyone because they're nice -- they're after total domination."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I agree. They stand against almost..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. They stand against almost every value that we cherish in Rizia."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I'm concerned about that too. I ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm concerned about that too. I hope they don't create problems for us."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""However, this in turn can open up..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, this in turn can open up many doors for us. Especially to Western Merkopa."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The Malenyevist ideology has no pl..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Malenyevist ideology has no place for our kingdom, but the CSP has been behaving pragmatically so far."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Nevertheless, this move will alien..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nevertheless, this move will alienate them further against us."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I know how difficult it is to make..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know how difficult it is to make that decision, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""They may not be our allies, but wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "They may not be our allies, but with this move, we aligned ourselves against the CSP."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I wouldn't trust them. They stand..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't trust them. They stand against almost every value that we cherish in Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We expected this to happen. This i..."
entries.dialogueText: "We expected this to happen. This is not a surprise for us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't worry -- this will be a bigg..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry -- this will be a bigger blow for their own economy than us. You'll see."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I nodded."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They'll come running back to us as..."
entries.dialogueText: "They'll come running back to us as soon as we claim our victory."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, I definitely don't trust him.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well, I definitely don't trust him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sure he'll respect the deal bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure he'll respect the deal but he's not our friend."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If he acts reckless -- this will b..."
entries.dialogueText: "If he acts reckless -- this will be a bigger blow for their own economy than us. Especially after we claim our victory."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Really? Arcasia has many values th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Really? Arcasia has many values that are inspirational to me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes. They are not only a threat to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. They are not only a threat to our monarchy but to the whole world."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We should be diplomatic with them.""
entries.dialogueText: "We should be diplomatic with them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't worry. I don't trust Arcasia..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. I don't trust Arcasia or the ATO."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Their story of economic developmen..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their story of economic development is definitely inspiring."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I agree, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I agree, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The councillors nodded."
entries.dialogueText: The councillors nodded.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Axa Victoria.""
entries.dialogueText: "Axa Victoria."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Axa Victoria.""
entries.dialogueText: "Axa Victoria."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Well, in any case... If they decid..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, in any case... If they decide to make a move, they'll likely time it with the upcoming Alliance of Nations session."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We may have a chance to have a wor..."
entries.dialogueText: "We may have a chance to have a word with Mr. Alvarez again there. Or possibly even Mr. Reinhart."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Another important point is our sch..."
entries.dialogueText: "Another important point is our scheduled meeting with the Wehzek president."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Your Majesty will have a chance to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty will have a chance to talk to President Smolak about the situation with Zille."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""He may bring up yet another unexpe..."
entries.dialogueText: "He may bring up yet another unexpected request or 'security issue'. Regardless of his theatrics, we should do our best to reach a final resolution to ensure the swift return of Zille."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""He has been uncooperative and we d..."
entries.dialogueText: "He has been uncooperative and we don't know if we can still reach a resolution with him to ensure the return of Zille."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""If all else fails, we can bring it..."
entries.dialogueText: "If all else fails, we can bring it up in the upcoming Alliance of Nations session."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All means are to be considered to..."
entries.dialogueText: "All means are to be considered to get Zille back."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't worry. I'll handle him.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. I'll handle him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It doesn't matter what President S..."
entries.dialogueText: "It doesn't matter what President Smolak thinks or does. Zille belongs to us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for the advice, Mr. Esqu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for the advice, Mr. Esquibel."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He nodded and continued."
entries.dialogueText: He nodded and continued.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We will get it back, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "We will get it back, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""We will certainly get it back, You..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will certainly get it back, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We'll get it back, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "We'll get it back, sir."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Unfortunately, we couldn't export..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, we couldn't export the promised amount of energy to Wehlen and our energy deal broke down. He will likely use this against us."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""On the other hand, our trade relat..."
entries.dialogueText: "On the other hand, our trade relations with Morella are very positive."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""On the other hand, our relations w..."
entries.dialogueText: "On the other hand, our relations with our southern neighbors are still not very positive."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The final vote on the MITZ issue,..."
entries.dialogueText: "The final vote on the MITZ issue, which will take place at the start of the next year, will be the defining factor for our long-term relations with them."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Our relations with Derdia, on the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our relations with Derdia, on the other hand, have blossomed after your visit."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Our relations with Derdia, on the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our relations with Derdia, on the other hand, have not changed much since your meeting with Grand Wiseman Azmal."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Our support with building a pipeli..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our support with building a pipeline between them and Morella gained us respect from both sides, but their disagreements with Wehlen still remain a major concern."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Their disputes with Morella and We..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their disputes with Morella and Wehlen still remain a major concern."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The fact that both of our nations..."
entries.dialogueText: "The fact that both of our nations are supporting the Bludish Freedom Front definitely factors into our relations."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Our continued support of Wehlen's..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our continued support of Wehlen's anti-Golcondist terrorist operations definitely factors into our relations."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""On the other hand, despite our tra..."
entries.dialogueText: "On the other hand, despite our trade, our relations with Morella are still not very positive."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Our stance on the MITZ seems to ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our stance on the MITZ seems to have alienated them. Unfortunately Chancellor Hegel seem to have enormous influence on Prime Minister Saltana."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is unfortunate that she isn't w..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is unfortunate that she isn't willing to compromise. I would have preferred to have good relations with Morella."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We knew this from the beginning. C..."
entries.dialogueText: "We knew this from the beginning. Chancellor Hegel is the real mastermind of this whole charade, and unfortunately he succeeded in sowing discord in the region already."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I couldn't care less. I will not l..."
entries.dialogueText: "I couldn't care less. I will not let them toy with our national interests."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We should do our best to normalize..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should do our best to normalize our relations with them. Nothing is a done deal."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Now that you have the word of Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that you have the word of Mr. Alvarez, we should be able to resolve this whole process once and for all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Great. This whole MITZ thing has t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Great. This whole MITZ thing has taken too long already."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""At this point, I couldn't care les..."
entries.dialogueText: "At this point, I couldn't care less about our relations with them. I'm not doing this to pick a side."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's more important is that we g..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's more important is that we get a result that is in our national interests. That will be my priority."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hate to put my trust on Mr. Alva..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hate to put my trust on Mr. Alvarez on this but we will see what happens soon enough."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He stopped for a moment to take a l..."
entries.dialogueText: He stopped for a moment to take a look at this notes.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Oh. Also Supreme Wiseman Azmal sen..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh. Also Supreme Wiseman Azmal sent us a letter, expressing gratitude to Rizia for showcasing 'some level of empathy', as he puts it, towards our Golcondist community."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Oh. Also Supreme Wiseman Azmal sen..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh. Also Supreme Wiseman Azmal sent us a letter, praising the 'divinely ordained changes,' as he puts it, that have helped our Golcondist community."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Oh. Also Supreme Wiseman Azmal sen..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh. Also Supreme Wiseman Azmal sent us a letter of condemnation, criticizing what he calls our 'continued oppression against Golcondists' in Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm not going to take advice from..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not going to take advice from a heretic who distorts our faith to reach their dark aims. May the Divine God save his soul."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm not going to take advice from..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not going to take advice from someone who calls themselves the 'Supreme Wiseman'."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Give me a break.""
entries.dialogueText: "Give me a break."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thanks for telling me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for telling me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""While I respect their efforts in r..."
entries.dialogueText: "While I respect their efforts in reaching Golconda, I don't need the sympathy of a heretic. May the Divine God save their souls."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't need the gratitude of anyo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't need the gratitude of anyone who calls himself a 'Supreme Wiseman'."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm glad he appreciates our effort..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad he appreciates our efforts."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Indeed, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Of course, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I know, Your Majesty. I know...""
entries.dialogueText: "I know, Your Majesty. I know..."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Halaita.""
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""May the Divine guide them to light.""
entries.dialogueText: "May the Divine guide them to light."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""And last but not least... Pales. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "And last but not least... Pales. But Your Majesty is already aware of the situation with Duke Reinhart."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""While the superpowers have only cu..."
entries.dialogueText: "While the superpowers have only cursorily acknowledged our invasion thus far, we're getting more and more attention from Merkopa as the operation progresses."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The royal wedding shall take place..."
entries.dialogueText: "The royal wedding shall take place after your upcoming visit to the Alliance of Nations."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I want to take this opportunity to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want to take this opportunity to congratulate Her Highness and His Majesty once again."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Thank you very much, Mr. Esquibel.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you very much, Mr. Esquibel."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Much appreciated, Laurento.""
entries.dialogueText: "Much appreciated, Laurento."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Save your congratulations for Vina..."
entries.dialogueText: "Save your congratulations for Vina when you see her. I know she's eagerly anticipating the wedding."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This will open the path to our reu..."
entries.dialogueText: "This will open the path to our reunification with Pales."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Indeed, Your Majesty. We are expec..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed, Your Majesty. We are expecting talks to begin soon after the marital alliance is sealed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento bowed his head respectfull..."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento bowed his head respectfully before continuing.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We have had a very stable relation..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have had a very stable relationship with the Grand Duchy since we signed our deal."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Since our last interactions with t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Since our last interactions with the Grand Duchy, its reliance on Lespia has only grown."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""This has in turn brought Pales clo..."
entries.dialogueText: "This has in turn brought Pales closer to Arcasia and ATO, which I fear will significantly disrupt the balance of power in our region."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Additionally, our recent military..."
entries.dialogueText: "Additionally, our recent military alliance with Pales has taken our relationship to daring new heights."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""So far, the PaleStream pipeline ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "So far, the PaleStream pipeline has also been very beneficial for both of our countries. It is a remarkable achievement."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""However, we failed to stop Duke Re..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, we failed to stop Duke Reinhart's close cooperation with Lespia. Despite our deals, his reliance on Lespia has only grown."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel

entries.dialogueText: "I will not stop until we achieve full reunification."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Keep up the good work, Mr. Esquibe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Keep up the good work, Mr. Esquibel. We wouldn't have achieved this without you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's not great. We can't let Pal..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's not great. We can't let Pales fall into the hands of the ATO."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We must find other ways to approac..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must find other ways to approach this before it's too late."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thanks for letting me know, Mr. Es..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for letting me know, Mr. Esquibel."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Send my congratulations to Duke Re..."
entries.dialogueText: "Send my congratulations to Duke Reinhart."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Yes, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Exactly.""
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Agreed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Agreed."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Agreed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Agreed."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita smiled."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita smiled.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I would not call it 'full' reunifi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would not call it 'full' reunification as long as the Reinharts are calling the shots, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""That's the spirit.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's the spirit."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Indeed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's not good news. We can't let..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's not good news. We can't let Pales fall into the hands of the ATO."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We must find other ways to approac..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must find other ways to approach this before it's too late."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thanks for letting me know, Mr. Es..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for letting me know, Mr. Esquibel."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "That damn boy Axel!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He bowed his head in respect."
entries.dialogueText: He bowed his head in respect.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a brief silence."
entries.dialogueText: There was a brief silence.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Our efforts in influencing the int..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our efforts in influencing the international media are paying off. Particularly in democratic countries, where citizens are pressuring their governments to back us."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I suspect additional condemnations..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suspect additional condemnations and sanctions may follow. We'll find out during the upcoming Alliance of Nations session, I'm sure."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Still, I suspect additional condem..."
entries.dialogueText: "Still, I suspect additional condemnations and sanctions will follow. We'll find out in the upcoming Alliance of Nations session, I'm sure."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Pales will soon pay for everything..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pales will soon pay for everything. I'm expecting our first operation to come to a successful conclusion in the next months."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Once our armies have surrounded th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Once our armies have surrounded their capital, we'll be able to bring a quick end to this war. Assuming the Duke is a logical man."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Unfortunately, the Palesian media'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, the Palesian media's exposé on our use of experimental weapons from Rumburg has the potential to turn the international community against us."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Unfortunately, the international c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, the international community will likely unite against us, now that our repeated use of experimental weapons from Rumburg has been made public by Palesian journalists."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""They're fools if they swallow that..."
entries.dialogueText: "They're fools if they swallow that one-sided coverage. We were completely within our right to do what we did."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked angry but full of resolv..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked angry but full of resolve.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you, Duchess Azaro.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Duchess Azaro."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We'll discuss the details in a sep..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll discuss the details in a separate military briefing, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good. I'm looking forward to it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good. I'm looking forward to it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm looking forward to some good n..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm looking forward to some good news. I hope I didn't make a mistake by granting the Azaros full authority over the operation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good. I'll need your input. Managi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good. I'll need your input. Managing the generals has been very stressful."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She saluted me."
entries.dialogueText: She saluted me.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You can trust us, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "You can trust us, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""That is all for the overview, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is all for the overview, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""That is all for the overview, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is all for the overview, Your Majesty. But there is one thing I wanted to discuss with you."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Despite it not being your initial..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite it not being your initial intention, we may still be able to bring our neighbors together in a potential regional alliance."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The collaborations and inter-depen..."
entries.dialogueText: "The collaborations and inter-dependencies we have formed thus far makes this a viable strategy we can potentially pursue."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It was your intention to pursue gr..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was your intention to pursue greater ties with our neighbors, and now it looks more realistic than ever before to bring them together in a potential regional alliance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't think we are ready to go t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think we are ready to go to that level with our neighbors yet. We shouldn't disturb the power dynamics by forming our separate pact."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I like the sound of it. Tell me mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I like the sound of it. Tell me more."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've been pursuing this strategy s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've been pursuing this strategy since the beginning. Let's talk about how we can form our own regional alliance in Southern Merkopa."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""With our current relations with ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "With our current relations with our neighbors, and the increasing pressure on our region by both the CSP and ATO, we have the perfect window of opportunity."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""And in the P.S. section of the let..."
entries.dialogueText: "And in the P.S. section of the letter we discovered a Golcondist curse."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I have prayed to Wruhec to dispel..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have prayed to Wruhec to dispel the bad spirits from Derdia."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""PaleStream is a crucial bargaining..."
entries.dialogueText: "PaleStream is a crucial bargaining chip that we have. We can provide cheaper gas to our other neighbors, connecting our economies even further."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""If our relations with Morella cont..."
entries.dialogueText: "If our relations with Morella continue on their current track of improvement, they can also be a potential partner in the region."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""If we can reach a resolution with..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we can reach a resolution with President Smolak over Zille, I believe they can also be a potential partner. Our treaty has already shown great promise."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""There is also Derdia. We've normal..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is also Derdia. We've normalized our relations with them, and I believe we can sway them towards a pact if we're able to assist them in their disputes with their neighbors."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Everyone in the region is looking..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everyone in the region is looking for more energy sources. They're under increasing pressure from the CSP and the ATO to subjugate themselves to the interests of the superpowers."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I truly believe that our national..."
entries.dialogueText: "I truly believe that our national interests align with those of our neighbors. And if we can connect our economies further and create balanced dependencies on each other..."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We can ensure peace and unity in S..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can ensure peace and unity in Southern Merkopa."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do you think we can realistically..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you think we can realistically form our own alliance in Southern Merkopa? How would the superpowers react to that?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I completely agree with that, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "I completely agree with that, Mr. Esquibel. How do you think we can proceed with this idea?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I think this might be going a litt..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think this might be going a little too far. We are not ready to clash with the superpowers."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't think we are ready to go t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think we are ready to go to that level with our neighbors yet. We shouldn't disturb power dynamics by forming our separate pact."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""As you wish, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""This isn't about clashing with the..."
entries.dialogueText: "This isn't about clashing with them. This is about offering an alternative for peace, and protecting the interests of Southern Merkopa."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are right, Mr. Esquibel. I thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are right, Mr. Esquibel. I think we should at least try to get our neighbors together. How do you think we can proceed with this idea?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""They will not like it, of course...."
entries.dialogueText: "They will not like it, of course. But what can they really do if we all come together to protect our independence?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""If we can lead such a peace initia..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we can lead such a peace initiative, I think this is realistically possible. It is all about ensuring that our countries are linked in a fundamental level that makes cutting ties a losing scenario for everyone."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""This is the only way to bring toge..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is the only way to bring together countries with vastly different ideologies and cultures like we have in Southern Merkopa."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We can lead the initiative to form..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can lead the initiative to form a neutral Southern Merkopan pact. This would require us to funnel a lot of resources into it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's a risk I'm willing to take...."
entries.dialogueText: "That's a risk I'm willing to take. It's about time for us to begin pulling away from GRACE, anyway."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't believe connecting our eco..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't believe connecting our economies and creating such dependencies will be good for anyone. It may fuel conflicts in the future and will give undue power to the countries with higher control over the most valuable resources."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""On second thought, I will not proc..."
entries.dialogueText: "On second thought, I will not proceed with this. Now is not the right time."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Well, Your Majesty. In case of a c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, Your Majesty. In case of a conflict, we will be the ones holding the keys. Such an alliance will only put Rizia in a stronger position."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't think so, Mr. Esquibel. Sh..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think so, Mr. Esquibel. Should we proceed with this idea, I predict catastrophe for the future of the region."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I see what you're getting at. Clev..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see what you're getting at. Clever."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're the expert. If you think th..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're the expert. If you think this plan is in the best interests of Rizia, I will not argue with you."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We can start the process by reachi..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can start the process by reaching out to our neighbors and preemptively funneling some funds into leading this initiative."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Shall I begin our efforts?""
entries.dialogueText: "Shall I begin our efforts?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes. I want this alliance to happe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. I want this alliance to happen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. Not at this time.""
entries.dialogueText: "No. Not at this time."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""As you wish, Your Majesty. I will..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, Your Majesty. I will keep you updated as developments occur."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""MorGas is a crucial bargaining chi..."
entries.dialogueText: "MorGas is a crucial bargaining chip that we have. We can provide cheaper gas to our other neighbors, connecting our economies even further."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Meanwhile, our alliance with Rumbu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Meanwhile, our alliance with Rumburg and GRACE is no longer bearing as much fruit as it once did. In fact, we are at risk of losing our GRACE membership."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Meanwhile, we are still on good te..."
entries.dialogueText: "Meanwhile, we are still on good terms with Rumburg and GRACE. But our distant geographical proximity limits the benefits we can get out of those alliances."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I urge you to reconsider.""
entries.dialogueText: "I urge you to reconsider."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What did it say?""
entries.dialogueText: "What did it say?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He checked his notes."
entries.dialogueText: He checked his notes.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""'May you die in the arms of a woma..."
entries.dialogueText: "'May you die in the arms of a woman.' Not much of a curse, if you ask me..."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""'May you perish from natural cause..."
entries.dialogueText: "'May you perish from natural causes, never knowing the holy fire of martyrdom.' Not much of a curse, if you ask me..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Uplifting those poor, oppressed so..."
entries.dialogueText: "Uplifting those poor, oppressed souls was the least I could do. Right, Grand Wiseman Ignacius?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Resentment simmered behind Sal's pl..."
entries.dialogueText: Resentment simmered behind Sal's placid expression.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Indeed, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Another hurried round of congratula..."
entries.dialogueText: Another hurried round of congratulations from everyone at the table followed.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I understand how much Rizia has in..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand how much Rizia has invested in this wedding. I won't let the kingdom down."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Duke Reinhart -- Axel -- and I hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duke Reinhart -- Axel -- and I have been speaking on the phone about the arrangements. I know he is very open to the idea of Rizian-Palesian reunification."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You had better not.""
entries.dialogueText: "You had better not."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's not all in your hands, Your H..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not all in your hands, Your Highness. As king, I will make sure the reunification process goes smoothly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Feel free to take some time off th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Feel free to take some time off the council if the pressure is too much for you."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""No, I'm fine. Thank you, Father.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, I'm fine. Thank you, Father."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina smiled weakly and said nothing..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina smiled weakly and said nothing.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I know, Father. Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "I know, Father. Thank you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He'd better be. We're giving him e..."
entries.dialogueText: "He'd better be. We're giving him enough in return."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's very good to hear, Your Hig..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's very good to hear, Your Highness."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So when will we able to proceed wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "So when will we able to proceed with the reunification talks?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Soon after the wedding. Assuming i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Soon after the wedding. Assuming it all goes smoothly, of course."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""As we should, Father. Axel's famil..."
entries.dialogueText: "As we should, Father. Axel's family has been championing Palesian independence for 30 years. Handing over the reins is not something he takes lightly."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""We will have to wait until after t..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will have to wait until after the wedding to proceed with reunification talks. But I'm expecting the process to go smoothly."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina blushed. Laurento bowed his he..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina blushed. Laurento bowed his head respectfully before continuing.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Thank you for laying the groundwor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for laying the groundwork, Your Highness. Duke Reinhart is a lucky man indeed."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""As are we all. I expect that Pales..."
entries.dialogueText: "As are we all. I expect that Palesian-Rizian reunification talks will begin soon after the marital alliance is sealed."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I expect that Palesian-Rizian reun..."
entries.dialogueText: "I expect that Palesian-Rizian reunification talks will begin soon after the marital alliance is sealed."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""But it is better than Lespia doing..."
entries.dialogueText: "But it is better than Lespia doing the same."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""That may not be possible as long a..."
entries.dialogueText: "That may not be possible as long as the Reinharts are in charge. But we've made significant strides forward."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""That will depend on the outcome of..."
entries.dialogueText: "That will depend on the outcome of next year's final MITZ board vote. I'm hoping for no last-minute surprises."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""But it does come at the risk of al..."
entries.dialogueText: "But it does come at the risk of alienating Rumburg. Queen Beatrice may see such an alliance as an affront to GRACE, especially at a time when her kingdom is facing increasing geopolitical isolation."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Our relations with Derdia, on the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our relations with Derdia, on the other hand, have soured since we refused the opportunity for a diplomatic visit."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Our relations with Derdia remain a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our relations with Derdia remain amicable, despite the fact that we refused to meet with Supreme Wiseman Azmal."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""On the other hand, our relations w..."
entries.dialogueText: "On the other hand, our relations with Morella has mostly been normalized."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Pales will soon pay for everything.""
entries.dialogueText: "Pales will soon pay for everything."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We are slowly normalizing our rela..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are slowly normalizing our relations with Lespia."
